Document.h2: Generally Positronic patterns fit one of 2 categories

p.b: *Occasionally the brand belongs to another company or LLC, not just CC so don't always assume!

Document.Box: FTS patterned borgs are NOT the property of CC and therefore should be handled as individuals responsible for their own actions with their own set of rights as a sophont

Branded borgs are the property of CC or the asset of another legal body (company/llc) and therefore their minds should be protected at all costs, while the bodies are expendable and can be more or less easily replaced, the minds are specialized tools which very likely cost more than you do if lost.
"but what about Xenoborgs, do those count as people or not"

Xenoborgs used to BE people, they're brains and patterns built from sophonts whom were integrated into the collective. if you're having to ask if being a victim makes them a person or not I think perhaps we may have some other issues we need to be addressing instead.
